definition_quote.value: Practice registered nursing means the performance of acts requiring substantial specialized knowledge, judgment, and skill based on the biological, physiological, behavioral, or sociological sciences as the basis for assessment, nursing diagnosis, planning, implementation, and evaluation of the practice of nursing in order to: (i) Maintain health; (ii) Prevent illness; or (iii) Care for or rehabilitate the ill, injured, or infirm.
definition_quote.quote: "Practice registered nursing" means the performance of acts requiring substantial specialized knowledge, judgment, and skill based on the biological, physiological, behavioral, or sociological sciences as the basis for assessment, nursing diagnosis, planning, implementation, and evaluation of the practice of nursing in order to: (i) Maintain health; (ii) Prevent illness; or (iii) Care for or rehabilitate the ill, injured, or infirm.

value: Supervision, delegation, and evaluation of nursing practice
Execution of therapeutic regimen including administration of medication and treatment
Independent nursing functions and delegated medical functions
methods_authorized.quote: For these purposes, "practice registered nursing" includes: (i) Administration; (ii) Teaching; (iii) Counseling; (iv) Supervision, delegation, and evaluation of nursing practice; (v) Execution of therapeutic regimen, including the administration of medication and treatment; (vi) Independent nursing functions and delegated medical functions

drug_authority.value: Nurse practitioners and nurse midwives may prescribe drugs including controlled substances on Schedules II-V. Nurse anesthetists may prescribe drugs including controlled dangerous substances for up to a 10-day supply in connection with anesthesia services. Clinical nurse specialists may prescribe drugs under Board regulations. Registered nurses may prepare and dispense drugs in limited public health settings.

aprn_role_categories.quote: Is certified by the Board to practice as: (i) A nurse practitioner; (ii) A nurse anesthetist; (iii) A nurse midwife; or (iv) A clinical nurse specialist.

lpn_supervision_requirements.quote: Except as provided in the rules and regulations of the Board adopted under § 8-205 of this title, a licensed practical nurse may practice licensed practical nursing only in a team relationship with at least one licensed health professional who is not a licensed practical nurse.

full_independent_practice_available.quote: "Practice as a registered nurse practitioner" means to independently: (1) Perform an act under subsection (o) of this section; (2) Conduct a comprehensive physical assessment of an individual; (3) Establish a medical diagnosis for common chronic stable or short–term health problems

full_independent_practice_experience_hou.quote: An applicant for initial certification as a registered nurse practitioner who has not been certified by the Board or any other board of nursing shall identify on the application for certification a mentor who will consult and collaborate with the applicant for 18 months beginning on the date the application for certification is received by the Board.

prescriptive_authority_certificate_requi.quote: "Nurse practitioner" means a registered nurse who is: (i) Certified as a nurse practitioner; and (ii) Authorized to prescribe drugs under regulations adopted by the Board.

opioid_prescribing_limits.value: Nurse anesthetists may only prescribe in amounts not exceeding a 10-day supply, only for individuals with whom the nurse anesthetist has established a client or patient record at the time of prescription, and only in connection with the delivery of anesthesia services.
opioid_prescribing_limits.quote: A nurse anesthetist may prescribe drugs under paragraph (1) of this subsection: (i) Only in an amount that does not exceed a 10–day supply; (ii) Only for an individual with whom the nurse anesthetist has, at the time of prescription, established a client or patient record; and (iii) Only in connection with the delivery of anesthesia services.
